description: Language-neutral exact-byte vectors for bounded local-only Draft 2020-12 schema loading, closure, validation, typed diagnostics, and determinism.

generatorContract.aggregateSchemaBytes: Generate count object schemas with deterministic absolute identifiers and ASCII description padding whose aggregate UTF-8 byte length is targetBytes.
generatorContract.anchorCount: Generate one object schema containing count distinct $anchor declarations under $defs.
generatorContract.diagnosticCount: Generate an instance array containing count JSON strings for an integer-items schema.

generatorContract.instanceDepth: Generate count nested JSON arrays around null.
generatorContract.referenceEdgeCount: Generate one object schema containing count repeated local $ref entries in allOf.
generatorContract.resourceCount: Generate one object schema with count resources including its root and absolute nested $id resources under $defs.
generatorContract.anchorScalars: Generate one object schema whose $anchor is count ASCII scalar values.
generatorContract.instanceBytes: Generate a two-item string array whose UTF-8 byte length is exactly targetBytes.
generatorContract.instanceStringScalars: Generate one JSON string containing count ASCII scalar values.
generatorContract.patternScalars: Generate one object schema whose pattern is count ASCII scalar values.
generatorContract.referenceScalars: Generate a root whose absolute $ref has exactly count ASCII scalars and, at the inclusive maximum, a Boolean target document with that exact identifier.
generatorContract.schemaDocumentBytes: Generate one valid object schema whose UTF-8 byte length is exactly targetBytes using bounded description and title strings.
generatorContract.schemaIdScalars: Generate one Boolean true schema with an absolute logical identifier of exactly count ASCII scalar values.
generatorContract.patternAdversarialInput: Generate one JSON string containing count ASCII a values followed by an exclamation mark to exercise an admitted catastrophic shape under NonBacktracking.
generatorContract.schemaDepth: Generate one object schema with exactly count nested schema containers using the not keyword.
generatorContract.referenceDepth: Generate one object schema whose count consecutive absolute $ref edges form an acyclic non-instance-consuming chain across count plus one resources.
generatorContract.schemaNodeCount: Generate one object schema with exactly count schema positions: its root plus unused Boolean schemas under $defs.
generatorContract.instanceNodeCount: Generate one JSON array with exactly count JSON values including the array root.
generatorContract.embeddedRootSiblingSchemaNodes: Generate one document with exactly count schema positions split between an embedded selected array resource and a large unreferenced embedded sibling resource.
generatorContract.evaluationPathMultiplicity: Generate one string schema with count converging two-branch reference layers; repeated paths to each shared target retain multiplicity, and the root pattern contributes canonical UTF-8 scan cost.
generatorContract.productiveRecursionDepth: Generate count nested object instances with a next property at every level and a terminal null value.
generatorContract.uniqueObjectArray: Generate count distinct object items with ordinal and targetBytes ASCII payload properties for a uniqueItems schema.
generatorContract.uniqueObjectArrayLateDuplicate: Generate count object items with targetBytes ASCII payload properties whose final reordered object is semantically equal to the first item.
